flow_context:
## Goal
Build a full-featured Laravel todo app with user authentication, task CRUD, categories, search, and tests.

setup.prompt: Set up the project environment and scaffold the Laravel todo app.

steps.label: task-model-migration
steps.prompt:
Create a Task model with migration. Fields:
- title (string, required)
- description (text, nullable)
- completed (boolean, default false)
- due_date (date, nullable)
- category_id (foreignId, nullable)
- user_id (foreignId, constrained to users)

Create a Category model with migration:
- name (string, required)
- color (string, nullable, hex color)
- user_id (foreignId, constrained to users)

Set up the relationships: Task belongsTo User and Category. Category belongsTo User and hasMany Tasks.

steps.label: task-controller-crud
steps.prompt:
Create a TaskController with full CRUD:
- index: list tasks for the authenticated user, with optional search by title and filter by category/completion status
- create: show create form with category dropdown
- store: validate and create
- edit: show edit form
- update: validate and update
- destroy: delete with confirmation

Also create a CategoryController:
- index: list user's categories
- store: create category (name, color)
- update: update category
- destroy: delete category (with check that no tasks reference it)

All controllers should be resourceful and use FormRequest validation.

steps.label: task-routes
steps.prompt:
Add routes for the task and category controllers in routes/web.php:
- Group under 'auth' middleware
- Prefix tasks under /tasks
- Prefix categories under /categories
- Add a dashboard route at /dashboard that shows task summary stats (total, completed, overdue counts)

Use Route::resource where appropriate.

steps.label: task-views
steps.prompt:
Create Blade views for the task management UI extending Breeze layouts:

tasks/index.blade.php:
- Search bar filtering by title
- Filter dropdowns for category and status (all/pending/completed)
- Table listing tasks with title, category badge (colored), due date, status toggle
- Each row has edit/delete buttons
- Responsive design

tasks/create.blade.php and tasks/edit.blade.php:
- Form with title, description (textarea), due_date (date picker), category dropdown
- Validation errors displayed inline

tasks/_form.blade.php:
- Shared form partial

categories/index.blade.php:
- List categories as colored badges/cards
- Inline edit form for name and color (use a color picker input)
- Delete button with confirmation modal

dashboard.blade.php:
- Stats cards: total tasks, completed, overdue, by category
- Recent tasks list (last 5)

Use Tailwind CSS classes consistent with Breeze's styling.

steps.label: task-category-policy
steps.prompt: Create a TaskPolicy and CategoryPolicy that scopes all operations to the authenticated user. Register them in AuthServiceProvider. Use the policies in the controllers.

steps.label: tests
steps.prompt:
Create feature tests for the todo app:
- TaskCreationTest: auth user can create task, validation errors show, guest is redirected
- TaskCompletionTest: toggle task completion status
- TaskFilterTest: search by title, filter by category and status
- CategoryTest: CRUD categories, cannot delete category with tasks
- DashboardTest: stats show correct counts

Use Laravel's built-in test helpers. Run tests and fix any failures.

steps.label: seeders
steps.prompt:
Create a database seeder that:
- Creates a demo user (demo@example.com / password)
- Creates 3-4 sample categories with colors
- Creates 10-15 sample tasks, some completed, some overdue, across categories

Run php artisan db:seed and verify data appears.
